name: vLLM Windows Build (vllm-windows-build)
description: Install native Windows builds of vLLM with OpenAI-compatible serving on NVIDIA GPUs, without WSL, Docker, or a Linux VM.
compatibility: OpenAI-compatible HTTP serving through vllm_launcher.py and the upstream OpenAI API server, including /v1/models and streaming.
limitations: This is a community native Windows distribution; official vLLM support is Linux-only.
Requires Windows 10 21H2 or later (x64), an NVIDIA GPU with SM 7.5 or newer, at least 12 GB VRAM (24 GB recommended), at least 16 GB RAM, and a CUDA 13.0 driver (R580 or newer).
Current wheels target Python 3.13 with CUDA 13.0, or Python 3.14 with CUDA 13.2.
v0.33.0 was GPU-validated on an RTX 3090. The Windows wheel does not include native Blackwell FP4 acceleration, and that 0.33.0 release has not been run on Blackwell hardware.

sources.note: Release coverage, system requirements, tested hardware, Linux-only official support, and Windows wheel scope.
OpenAI-compatible HTTP server modes, including vllm_launcher.py and /v1/models.
